Shared object-prefix family inspected: 08FC8, D14C, D550, D884 and DF14, plus gl_func_0003800C and gl_func_00039990. TimB5ObjectPrefix preserves offset names; +0x14 holds the parent pointer and +0x28 receives a descriptor address.
Outer +0x29C/+0x2B8 reference the child; +0x2B0 stores a2; float +0x2A4 stores converted a1; float +0x134 receives an imported constant.
Child +0x108 references the grandchild. Six floats populate +0xDC/+0xE0/+0xE4 and +0x110/+0x114/+0x118. Floats +0x10C/+0x124 receive zero and +0x120 receives 1.0; words +0x12C/+0x130 receive zero.

Grandchild +0x28 receives a descriptor pointer; floats +0x108/+0x10C/+0x110 receive an imported constant; word +0x120 receives 1; float +0x124 receives 1.0. Its vector at +0xB4/+0xB8/+0xBC is cleared.

Owner+0x6C is incremented; its previous value indexes the pointer array at +0x3C. Imported flag word import_8005EE6C+4 has bit 0x80000 saved, cleared and restored around the unresolved call; bit 0x2000 is set.

Defining the grandchild pointer before a basic-block split preserves v1. Splitting the later outer stores and retaining the final list-address candidate reproduces the original argument preparation and spill order. Applied the pinned IDO_CODEGEN dead-v0-poison-per-basic-block recipe.

Normal and NON_MATCHING C each match all 820 expected bytes, SHA256 4952ba9855c8eaf07cf3a69610c94e98f7754b73fa40c61e16b7f5a6dadb55df. INCLUDE_ASM is removed. Objdiff fuzzy is 99.541466% because relocation metadata differs; raw instructions are exact.

ROM MD5 is fa27089c425dbab99f19245c5c997613; all six compressed blocks pass; this unit’s 96 previously exact functions remain exact. Other function bodies are unchanged. Compiler flags, expected objects, assembly and metrics were not modified.
